name: ttrpg-map-generator
description: Offline world-to-region fantasy map generator and editor

scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/run-vitest-with-heap.mjs run apps/desktop/src/milestone-one-proof-workflow.test.ts apps/desktop/src/atlas-workflow.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/src/atlas-workflow-png.test.ts apps/desktop/src/atlas-workflow-generation.integration.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test mapworld_native_recovery workflow -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
scripts.test:visual: vitest run scripts/render-scene-png.test.mjs scripts/atlas-png-export-fixtures.test.mjs apps/desktop/src/milestone-one-proof-scene.test.ts apps/desktop/src/milestone-one-proof-evidence.test.ts && node scripts/fixture-conventions.mjs check
scripts.test:png-export: vitest run packages/render/src/atlas-png-encoder.test.mjs packages/render/src/atlas-png-rasterizer.test.ts packages/render/src/atlas-png-export.test.ts scripts/atlas-png-export-fixtures.test.mjs scripts/atlas-png-large-export.test.mjs apps/desktop/src/atlas-png-native-boundary.test.ts apps/desktop/src/atlas-png-export-orchestrator.test.ts apps/desktop/src/atlas-workflow-png.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml atlas_png -- --test-threads=1
scripts.precommit: node scripts/check-staged-files.mjs && corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm rust:fmt && corepack pnpm rust:clippy && corepack pnpm rust:test
